shortDescription: Adds or removes mysql hosts from proxysql admin interface

options.name: comment
options.description: Text field that can be used for any purposed defined by the user. Could be a description of what the host stores, a reminder of when the host was added or disabled, or a JSON processed by some checker script.

options.name: compression
options.description: If the value of I(compression) is greater than 0, new connections to that server will use compression. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(compression) is 0.

options.name: config_file
options.description: Specify a config file from which I(login_user) and I(login_password) are to be read.

options.name: hostgroup_id
options.description: The hostgroup in which this mysqld instance is included. An instance can be part of one or more hostgroups.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The ip address at which the mysqld instance can be contacted.

options.name: load_to_runtime
options.description: Dynamically load config to runtime memory.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The host used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password used to authenticate to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The port used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_unix_socket
options.description: The socket used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username used to authenticate to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: max_connections
options.description: The maximum number of connections ProxySQL will open to this backend server. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(max_connections) is 1000.

options.name: max_latency_ms
options.description: Ping time is monitored regularly. If a host has a ping time greater than I(max_latency_ms) it is excluded from the connection pool (although the server stays ONLINE). If omitted the proxysql database default for I(max_latency_ms) is 0.

options.name: max_replication_lag
options.description: If greater than 0, ProxySQL will regularly monitor replication lag. If replication lag goes above I(max_replication_lag), proxysql will temporarily shun the server until replication catches up. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(max_replication_lag) is 0.

options.name: port
options.description: The port at which the mysqld instance can be contacted.

options.name: save_to_disk
options.description: Save config to sqlite db on disk to persist the configuration.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present) - adds the host, when C(absent) - removes the host.

options.name: status
options.description:
ONLINE - Backend server is fully operational. OFFLINE_SOFT - When a server is put into C(OFFLINE_SOFT) mode, connections are kept in use until the current transaction is completed. This allows to gracefully detach a backend. OFFLINE_HARD - When a server is put into C(OFFLINE_HARD) mode, the existing connections are dropped, while new incoming connections aren't accepted either.
If omitted the proxysql database default for I(status) is C(ONLINE).

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If I(use_ssl) is set to C(True), connections to this server will be made using SSL connections. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(use_ssl) is C(False).

options.name: weight
options.description: The bigger the weight of a server relative to other weights, the higher the probability of the server being chosen from the hostgroup. If omitted the proxysql database default for I(weight) is 1.
